title: Service of notices
bodyMd:
The records distinguish notices assigned from those successfully served during the period. Each success relates to one assigned notice.

| Category | Assigned notices | Served notices |
|---|---:|---:|
| Urban | 80 | 72 |
| Suburban | 160 | 128 |
| Rural | 160 | 112 |
